facts.text: Caroline shared a memory of attending a pride parade a few weeks prior, which she described as a special experience.

evidence.quote: One special memory for me was this pride parade I went to a few weeks ago.

facts.text: Caroline confirmed that she participated in the pride parade and felt accepted and happy during the event.

evidence.quote: Yes, I did. It was amazing! I felt so accepted and happy, just being around people who accepted and celebrated me.
